read.thesis: Middle East supply shock has taken polyethylene to above mid-cycle margins; Q2 guide of ~$12B revenue and $2B EBITDA includes only April's $0.30/lb price move, with May's $0.20/lb as upside.

utilisation.quote: Industry operating rates surged to 97% while DTI declined.

capex.peers_comment: Management said anticipated potential delays or cancellations of planned industry capacity additions.
capex.quote: capital expenditures expected to be at or below depreciation and amortization across the cycle

triggers.label: Industry rates 97%, DTI down
triggers.quote: Industry operating rates surged to 97% while DTI declined.

triggers.label: $0.26/lb PE margin uplift in Q2
triggers.quote: there is $0.26 per pound of margin improvement globally that is baked into that

triggers.label: ~3/4 of announced capacity impacted
triggers.quote: roughly three quarters of announced global capacity additions would be either directly impacted by the conflict or dependent on supply chains that remain highly constrained

triggers.label: Europe siloxanes capacity cut 25%
triggers.quote: This capacity represents approximately 25% of European siloxane industry capacity.

triggers.label: Sadara losses ~$400M FY, GAAP suspended
triggers.quote: On a full-year basis, we would estimate that to be in the approximately $400 million range

red_flags.label: Sadara losses and cash obligations
red_flags.quote: future annual cash commitments related to Sadara are projected at approximately $100 million per year through 2038

red_flags.label: Sadara GAAP equity loss recognition suspended
red_flags.quote: we are in a position to suspend further recognition of the Sadara equity losses
